appctl:
Usage: appctl [options] [command]

My App CLI — command-line client for the API.

Options:
  -v, --version                  Print the version and exit
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]                 Create infra/compose/.env so this checkout can
                                 be started
  login [options]                Authorize this machine and store a token
  api [options] <method> <path>  Call any API endpoint and print the response
  config                         Show the stored server URL and a masked token
                                 hint
  node                           Run this machine as a worker node for the
                                 application’s job queue
  deploy                         Check, install and update this application on a
                                 server
  android                        Build, sign and publish the Android app
  help [command]                 display help for command
appctl init:
Usage: appctl init [options]

Create infra/compose/.env so this checkout can be started

Options:
  --force                Update an existing .env in place, keeping the values
                         already in it
  --non-interactive      Never prompt: generate the secrets, take every default,
                         leave OAuth blank
  --admin-email <email>  Set INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL without being asked for it
  --all                  Review every variable, not only the ones that must be
                         answered
  --repo-root <path>     Repository root (default: this directory or a parent)
  -h, --help             display help for command
appctl login:
Usage: appctl login [options]

Authorize this machine and store a token

Options:
  --server <url>        Server URL (or set APPCTL_SERVER_URL)
  --token <pat>         Skip the device flow and use an existing personal access
                        token (headless)
  --device-name <name>  Name shown for this machine in the Access Tokens page
  --no-browser          Do not try to open a browser; just print the URL
  -h, --help            display help for command
appctl api:
Usage: appctl api [options] <method> <path>

Call any API endpoint and print the response

Arguments:
  method               HTTP method (GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE,
                       OPTIONS)
  path                 Request path, e.g. /api/auth/me

Options:
  --query <key=value>  Query parameter; repeat for more than one
  --data <json>        Request body: inline JSON, @file.json, or - for stdin

  -q, --quiet          Suppress the status line and spinner on stderr
  --no-color           Disable colour even on a terminal
  --timeout <ms>       Per-request timeout in milliseconds
  -h, --help           display help for command

appctl node:
Usage: appctl node [options] [command]

Run this machine as a worker node for the application’s job queue

Options:
  -h, --help              display help for command

Commands:
  config [options]        Show the worker settings this machine would start with
  enroll [options]        Log in and mint a node credential for this machine, in
                          one step
  register [options]      Register (or re-attach) this machine as a worker node
  start [options]         Run this machine as a worker until stopped
  stop                    Stop the worker running on this machine
  status [options]        Report what the worker on this machine is doing
  logs [options]          Show this worker’s log
  set-concurrency <n>     Change how many jobs this worker runs at once, live if
                          it is running
  doctor [options]        Check this machine, the server, and the worker —
                          independently
  install-deps [options]  Install the dependencies this worker’s job types need
  service                 Manage the worker as a systemd user service
  heap-snapshot           Ask the running worker to write a heap snapshot
  help [command]          display help for command

appctl deploy:
Usage: appctl deploy [options] [command]

Check, install and update this application on a server

Options:
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  doctor [options]     Check that this server meets the prerequisites
  install [options]    Install this application on this server
  update [options]     Bring this server up to the latest revision
  status [options]     Report whether the deployment on this server is healthy
  list [options]       List every deployment on this server
  about [options]      Show what this server says it is running
  certs [options]      Inspect or renew this deployment's TLS certificate
  uninstall [options]  Remove a deployment from this server
  help [command]       display help for command
appctl deploy doctor:
Usage: appctl deploy doctor [options]

Check that this server meets the prerequisites

Options:
  --root <path>             Deployment directory (rank 1: an explicit path)
  --apps-root <path>        Directory holding the deployments (rank 3 walks up
                            inside it) (default: "/opt/infra/apps")
  --name <app>              Which deployment to act on, by name
  --proxy-root <path>       Shared reverse proxy directory (default:
                            "/opt/infra/proxy")
  --port <port>             Loopback port the proxy forwards to (default:
                            "3535")
  --domain <domain>         Public domain; enables the DNS and TLS checks
  --proxy-container <name>  Name of the shared proxy container (default: as
                            recorded, else proxy-nginx)
  --proxy-mode <mode>       How the shared proxy runs: container or host
                            (default: as recorded, else detected)
  --repo <url>              Repository whose access to check (default: the
                            recorded one, then this checkout's origin)
  --json                    Print a machine-readable report on stdout
  --no-color                Disable colour even on a terminal
  -h, --help                display help for command
appctl deploy install:
Usage: appctl deploy install [options]

Install this application on this server

Options:
  --root <path>             Deployment directory (rank 1: an explicit path)
  --apps-root <path>        Directory holding the deployments (rank 3 walks up
                            inside it) (default: "/opt/infra/apps")
  --name <app>              Which deployment to act on, by name
  --domain <domain>         Public domain to publish under
  --proxy-root <path>       Shared reverse proxy directory (default:
                            "/opt/infra/proxy")
  --proxy-container <name>  Name of the shared proxy container (default: as
                            recorded, else proxy-nginx)
  --proxy-mode <mode>       How the shared proxy runs: container or host
                            (default: as recorded, else detected)
  --port <port>             Loopback port the proxy forwards to (default:
                            "3535")
  --repo <url>              Repository to deploy (default: this checkout's
                            origin)
  --ref <ref>               Branch, tag or commit (default: the remote default
                            branch)
  --email <email>           Certificate registration address
  --group <name>            Optional feature group; repeat for more (default:
                            [])
  --all                     Review every environment variable, not only the
                            essential ones
  --non-interactive         Never prompt; fail listing anything unresolved
  --answer <key=value>      Supply one environment answer; repeat for more
                            (default: {})
  --answers-file <path>     Read answers from a KEY=value file (like .env)
  --reinstall               Install over an existing deployment
  --resume                  Continue from the step that failed
  --skip-doctor             Skip the prerequisite checks
  --skip-proxy              Do not touch the reverse proxy or request a
                            certificate
  --skip-seed               Do not run the database seed
  --bootstrap-proxy         Create the shared proxy if this server has none (no
                            prompt)
  --create-database         Create the database if it does not exist (no prompt)
  --skip-renewal            Do not schedule certificate renewal
  --skip-oauth-check        Do not verify the Google OAuth credentials with
                            Google
  --no-cache                Rebuild images without the layer cache
  --force                   Discard uncommitted changes in the checkout
  --staging                 Use Let's Encrypt staging while working out the
                            setup
  --app-version <version>   Release version to deploy (default: a patch bump of
                            the current one)
  --no-version-bump         Deploy the current version: no write, no commit, no
                            push
  --json                    Print a machine-readable result on stdout
  -h, --help                display help for command
appctl deploy update:
Usage: appctl deploy update [options]

Bring this server up to the latest revision

Options:
  --root <path>             Deployment directory (rank 1: an explicit path)
  --apps-root <path>        Directory holding the deployments (rank 3 walks up
                            inside it) (default: "/opt/infra/apps")
  --name <app>              Which deployment to act on, by name
  --ref <ref>               Branch, tag or commit to move to
  --force                   Rebuild even when the revision has not changed
  --no-cache                Rebuild images without the layer cache
  --non-interactive         Never prompt; fail listing anything unresolved
  --answer <key=value>      Supply one environment answer; repeat for more
                            (default: {})
  --answers-file <path>     Read answers from a KEY=value file (like .env)
  --skip-seed               Do not re-run the database seed
  --skip-proxy              Do not touch the reverse proxy
  --create-database         Create the database if it does not exist (no prompt)
  --skip-renewal            Do not schedule certificate renewal
  --skip-oauth-check        Do not run the post-deploy OAuth sign-in smoke
  --proxy-container <name>  Name of the shared proxy container (default: as
                            recorded, else proxy-nginx)
  --proxy-mode <mode>       How the shared proxy runs: container or host
                            (default: as recorded, else detected)
  --app-version <version>   Release version to deploy (default: a patch bump of
                            the current one)
  --no-version-bump         Deploy the current version: no write, no commit, no
                            push
  --maintenance             Serve a 503 from before the build until just after
                            restart, instead of whatever the
                            stop/migrate/restart window looks like underneath
  --json                    Print a machine-readable result on stdout
  -h, --help                display help for command
